opportunities.title: Undergraduate Research Internship Program (UGRIP)
opportunities.description: MBZUAI's flagship fully funded, four-week experiential AI research internship for undergraduates worldwide, held on the Abu Dhabi campus. Interns work on a research project in core AI disciplines such as computer vision, computer science, machine learning, natural language processing, and robotics; projects may also explore human-computer interaction, computational biology, and data science. Official 2026 program dates were Monday 1 June through Friday 26 June 2026. 2026 projects were introduced during the first two days of the program; interns then nominated project preferences. Official benefits listed for the residency include a stipend, accommodation and health insurance, visa, airfares, airport transfers, social and cultural activities, and access to MBZUAI student facilities.
opportunities.eligibility: Official UGRIP requirements: undergraduate students in the penultimate year of a STEM-related major and graduating after August 2026; minimum CGPA of 3.5 (on a 4.0 scale) or equivalent; must meet MBZUAI's English language requirement for admission into Ph.D. programs. Required documentation listed on the official page includes an enrollment letter, official transcript, proof of English proficiency or a medium-of-instruction letter, passport copy, statement of purpose, and curriculum vitae.

opportunities.title: Master of Science Programs
opportunities.description: University-wide MBZUAI M.Sc. admission cycle. Official graduate-admission materials state that M.Sc. Year 1 funding is not automatic: students are fee-paying by default, though merit-based funding may be available and is considered during the admissions review process. If funding is secured, it is through a faculty advisor-sponsored research/teaching assistantship, an approved government scholarship for UAE nationals, or merit-based funding; funding is not guaranteed for all admitted students. The Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence (MAAI) is a separate fee-based program and is not eligible for University or faculty-sponsored funding. Official FAQ states there is no separate faculty-matching or funding application. Current cycle: application portal opened 7 September 2026 (8 a.m. GST); final application deadline 15 December 2026 (5 p.m. GST); decision notification no later than 31 March 2027 (5 p.m. GST).
opportunities.eligibility: Official graduate-admission general requirements: a STEM degree such as computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, mathematics, physics, or another relevant science or engineering major from an accredited university or college recognized by the UAE Ministry of Education, with a minimum CGPA of 3.0 or 3.5 (on a 4.0 scale) depending on the program. Senior-level students may apply with a transcript and must submit the completed degree certificate/transcript upon admission. Program pages for M.Sc. degrees such as Computer Science specify a completed bachelor's degree in a STEM field with a minimum CGPA of 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale) or equivalent. Required application materials include a CV, statement of purpose, referee recommendations (minimum of two for M.Sc. applicants), English proficiency evidence, and other documents listed on the graduate admission process page. A screening exam and, for a subset of applicants, a technical interview are part of the process.

opportunities.title: Ph.D. Programs
opportunities.description: University-wide MBZUAI doctoral admission cycle. Official Ph.D. programs materials state that all doctoral programs offer a full scholarship including tuition, accommodation, healthcare, student visa, and a monthly stipend. Official graduate-admission funding materials state that Ph.D. Year 1 is centrally funded by the University while the student matches with a faculty advisor; funding then moves to the faculty advisor no later than the start of Year 2, subject to a confirmed advisor match and satisfactory progress. Official FAQ states there is no separate faculty-matching or funding application. Funded students receive free tuition, a monthly stipend, one return airfare each year to their home country, health insurance, and a University-sponsored UAE residence visa and Emirates ID where eligible. Official stipend table: UAE nationals AED 43,500; international students AED 17,500. Current cycle: application portal opened 7 September 2026 (8 a.m. GST); final application deadline 15 December 2026 (5 p.m. GST); decision notification no later than 31 March 2027 (5 p.m. GST).
opportunities.eligibility: Official graduate-admission general requirements: a STEM degree such as computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, mathematics, physics, or another relevant science or engineering major from an accredited university or college recognized by the UAE Ministry of Education, with a minimum CGPA of 3.0 or 3.5 (on a 4.0 scale) depending on the program. Senior-level students may apply with a transcript and expected graduation letter and must submit the completed degree certificate/transcript upon admission. Individual Ph.D. program pages, such as Computer Science, specify either a bachelor's degree with a minimum CGPA of 3.5 (on a 4.0 scale) or a master's degree with a minimum CGPA of 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale). Required application materials include a CV, statement of purpose, research statement, referee recommendations (minimum of three for Ph.D. applicants), English proficiency evidence, and other documents listed on the graduate admission process page. A screening exam and, for a subset of applicants, a technical interview are part of the process.
